One coherent system

The square frame is a place; the continuous stroke is a mark. Keep one symbol-width of clear space around the lockup. Minimum symbol 24px; favicon 16px is a dedicated exception. Never stretch, rotate or recolor the mark with creator colors.

MAKE IT YOURS.

Heavy sans headings; system UI for controls and reading; tabular numerals for server prices and timers. 4px spacing base; 8px controls, 16px cards, pill status labels. Flat by default, optional small overlay shadow. No gradients or decorative animation.

Export-ready essentials

Accessibility and handoff

20 approved text/control pairings: text passes 4.5:1; meaningful control boundaries and focus pass 3:1. Never communicate status by color alone. Controls have 44px targets. Verify keyboard focus, 200% zoom, long names and creator artwork contrast on every integrated screen. Generated contrast data lives in contrast.json; usage and limits in README.md.
